sentences.zh: ○紹興鹵簿皇太后皇后鹵簿皇太子鹵簿妃附王公以下鹵簿

translations.literal: ○ Shaoxing imperial guard of honor; empress dowager and empress guard of honor; crown prince guard of honor; consorts appended; princes and officials of lower rank guard of honor
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Shaoxing-era imperial procession escorts; escorts for the empress dowager and empress; escorts for the crown prince; consorts (appended); and escorts for princes and officials of lower rank

translations.literal: Shaoxing imperial guard of honor.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaoxing-era imperial procession escort.

sentences.zh: 宋初，大駕用一萬一千二百二十二人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Song, the grand imperial procession employed 11,222 persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Song, the full state procession required 11,222 personnel.

sentences.zh: 宣和，增用二萬六十一人。

translations.literal: In the Xuanhe reign, the number was increased by 20,061 persons.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Xuanhe reign, another 20,061 were added.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，裁定一千三百三十五人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianyan reign, it was fixed at 1,335 persons.
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of the Jianyan era, the establishment was cut to 1,335.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，用宋初之數，十六年以後，遂用一萬五千五十人；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaoxing, the early-Song figure was used; after the sixteenth year, 15,050 persons were then employed;
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shaoxing reign the early-Song total was restored; after the sixteenth year of Shaoxing the establishment stood at 15,050;

sentences.zh: 明堂三分省一，用一萬一十五人，孝宗用六千八百八十九人，明堂用三千三百十九人。

translations.literal: For the Hall of Enlightened Rule, one-third was cut, employing 10,015 persons; Xiaozong used 6,889 persons, and for the Hall of Enlightened Rule 3,319 persons.
translations.idiomatic: For rites at the Hall of Enlightened Rule the force was reduced by one-third, to 10,015; under Xiaozong the regular establishment was 6,889, and for the hall rites 3,319.

translations.literal: Thereafter, Xiaozong's figures were used throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Xiaozong's establishments were adopted as the standard.

translations.literal: In Shaoxing, six elephants were used, and one spare elephant.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shaoxing, six ceremonial elephants were deployed, with one spare.

sentences.zh: （乾道用象一，淳熙用象六而不設副，紹熙如乾道，慶元後不設。）〉

translations.literal: (In Qiandao one elephant was used; in Chunxi six elephants were used without a spare; in Shaoxi it followed Qiandao; after Qingyuan they were not deployed.)]
translations.idiomatic: (Qiandao used one elephant; Chunxi used six with no spare; Shaoxi followed Qiandao; after Qingyuan elephants were omitted.)]

translations.idiomatic: Six vanguard sections.

translations.idiomatic: The first vanguard: two path-clearers;

translations.idiomatic: (Under Xiaozong these were cut.)]

translations.literal: one canopied crossbowman, mounted;
translations.idiomatic: one mounted crossbowman with canopy;

translations.idiomatic: one square parasol, two floral fans, and one curved canopy;
